2607.23116.title: KAYROS: An Anytime and Exact Open-Source Solver for Duration-Minimization Time-Dependent Vehicle Routing. A Technical Report and a Case Study in Human-AI Engineering
2607.23116.paper_summary: KAYROS is an open-source solver for duration-minimization time-dependent vehicle routing problems, with or without time windows (TDVRPTW, TDVRP). In these variants, travel times change with departure time, and each route's dispatch time is a decision. To the best of the author's knowledge, it is the first openly available solver that is both anytime, streaming improving solutions from the first seconds, and exact, proving optimality with publicly verifiable certificates, for these problems over rich piecewise-linear travel- time functions rather than a time discretization. It has no proprietary dependency and installs with one command. It builds on the state of the art for time-dependent function composition and exact solving, extending the open-source branch-price-and-cut solver of Lera-Romero, Miranda Bront and Soulignac (2020) with an open LP backend, anytime and warm- start behavior, checker-exact pricing, and exact treatment of stepwise travel times. On the MAMUT-routing benchmark collection, KAYROS stands behind 468 published optimality certificates, each requiring agreement among four independent solves, and five certificates strictly improve published reference values. The report also introduces Poryos2026, a benchmark family designed and generated by the author from real OpenStreetMap city road networks. Its 1,080 paired CVRP, VRPTW, TDVRP and TDVRPTW instances combine real road geometries with controlled synthetic demands, time windows and congestion. Every instance carries a checker-validated best-known solution. This report presents the solver, its certification protocol, the benchmark's generation and feasibility guarantees, and their experimental connection for a broad technical audience. It is also a case study in the intensive human-AI collaboration that made this body of work feasible while keeping its claims independently verifiable.
2607.23116.paper_summary_zh: KAYROS 是一個開源的解決方案，用於持續最小化的時間依賴性車輛路由問題，無論是否有時間窗口 (TDVRPTW, TDVRP)。在這些變體中，旅行時間隨著出發時間而變化，每條路線的發車時間都是一個決策。據作者所知，它是第一個公開可用的解決方案，既是隨時可用的，從第一秒開始不斷改進解決方案，也是精確的，通過公開可驗證的證書證明最優性，針對這些問題使用豐富的分段線性旅行時間函數，而不是時間離散化。它沒有專有依賴，並且可以通過一個命令進行安裝。它基於時間依賴性函數組合和精確解決的最新技術，擴展了 Lera-Romero、Miranda Bront 和 Soulignac (2020) 的開源分支定價與切割解決方案，具有開放的 LP 後端、隨時可用和熱啟動行為、檢查精確定價以及對階段性旅行時間的精確處理。在 MAMUT-routing 基準集合中，KAYROS 支持 468 個已發表的最優性證書，每個證書都需要四個獨立解決方案之間的協議，並且五個證書明確改善了已發表的參考值。報告還介紹了 Poryos2026，這是一個由作者根據真實的 OpenStreetMap 城市道路網絡設計和生成的基準系列。它的 1,080 個配對 CVRP、VRPTW、TDVRP 和 TDVRPTW 實例結合了真實的道路幾何形狀與受控的合成需求、時間窗口和擁堵。每個實例都攜帶一個檢查驗證的最佳已知解。這份報告介紹了解決方案、其認證協議、基準的生成和可行性保證，以及它們與廣泛技術觀眾的實驗聯繫。這也是一個關於密集的人類與 AI 合作的案例研究，這使得這一系列工作成為可能，同時保持其主張的獨立可驗證性。
